title: Rectangle Const Query Functions
prompt_md:
## Goal
Mark read-only member functions `const` so they can be called on `const` objects and `const` references. Complete a `Rectangle` whose query functions are const-correct.

## Input
- Line 1: two doubles `width height`.

## Output
- Line 1: `Area: <width * height>` to 2 decimal places.
- Line 2: `Square: yes` if width equals height, otherwise `Square: no`.

## What to build
Add two const member functions to `Rectangle`: `double area() const` and `bool isSquare() const`. They must be `const` because the provided `printInfo(const Rectangle&)` receives the object by const reference and may only call const member functions on it.

title: Box Volume and Surface Area (const member functions)
prompt_md:
## Goal
Practice const member functions on a type with several read-only queries. Report the volume and surface area of a stream of boxes.

## Input
- Line 1: an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 100), the number of boxes.
- Next N lines: three integers `width height depth` per line.

## Output
- For each box, one line: `Volume: <v>, Surface: <s>`, where v is width*height*depth and s is the total area of all six faces.

## What to build
Add const member functions `int volume() const` and `int surfaceArea() const` to the `Box` class. Both must be const because the provided `report(const Box&)` takes each box by const reference.
